title: Backstop MCP Values
description: Values for the Backstop MCP Helm chart. Python FastMCP server with OAuth credential bridging to Backstop CRM. Exposure uses base chart Gateway API routes (no custom Ingress).

tenantGuidance.description: Text appended to the server instructions and to individual tool and parameter descriptions. Empty means the shipped descriptions only. Set per deployment; the chart ships tenant-neutral.

server_instructions.description: Free text appended to the server instructions.

tools.description: Per-tool text, keyed by tool name.

description.description: Free text appended to this tool's description.

parameters.description: Free text appended to a top-level input property, keyed by property name.
